entries.summary: Add oha_award_demo_stamp AJAX endpoint for pre-event OHA Beginner stamp
entries.notes: Awards stamp_type='demo', event_slug='pre-event', actor_two_id=0. One per user. Does NOT check is_event_active() so it works before convention dates. Updates stamps_earned counter. Registered in OHA_Passport_Stamps constructor.

entries.summary: Add oha_convention_passport to page_needs_passport_assets() shortcode list
entries.notes: The [oha_convention_passport] shortcode lives in OHA Convention PWA Core (not Passport Hub). Without this addition, Passport Hub JS/CSS would not load on the passport page because has_shortcode() would never match. This makes Passport Hub assets load whenever the PWA Core passport shortcode is on the page.

entries.summary: Profile card header flex-wrap fix on small screens
entries.notes: Added flex-wrap:wrap, gap:6px to .passport-header; min-width:0 + overflow-wrap on h4; flex-shrink:0 + white-space:nowrap on .character-type

entries.summary: Post-scan success shows dual actions: Scan More and View My Passport buttons
entries.notes: displayScanSuccess() and processActorScan() both render oha-scan-after-actions div with two buttons. passport_page_url localized from oha_pwa_passport_url WP option.

entries.summary: Scanner pages show a link to the passport page below the scan result area
entries.notes: Both display_qr_scanner() and display_smart_scanner() accept passport_url shortcode attr, default from oha_pwa_passport_url option. Renders .oha-scanner-passport-link div.

entries.summary: passport_page_url added to wp_localize_script so JS can link back to passport page
entries.notes: Reads oha_pwa_passport_url WP option (shared with PWA Core). Falls back to /convention/2026-convention/passport/.

entries.summary: Replace hardcoded /convention/2026-convention/passport/ fallback with oha_convention_base_url dynamic default
entries.notes: Fixed in oha-passport-hub.php (passport_page_url localize) and class-passport-shortcodes.php (oha_qr_scanner and oha_smart_scanner shortcode_atts). Fallback now derives from oha_convention_base_url option so no plugin edits needed when convention year changes.

entries.summary: Fix hardcoded 2026-convention/passport/ JS fallbacks in passport-hub.js
entries.notes: Two JS safety-net fallbacks in passport-hub.js (displayScanSuccess and processActorScan) changed from /convention/2026-convention/passport/ to /convention/passport/. These only fire if ohaPassportHub.passport_page_url is not set by PHP, which should not happen in production.
